// dir: y
// want: analyzer "file-size" declares "max_lines", nothing reads it
// want: y run: a read in y is not attributable to one of [text-markers typo]
// with: pass

func run(ctx pass.Context, list []pass.ParamSet) {
	params := ctx.Params("typo")
	for _, params = range list {
		_ = params.Int("max_lines", 1)
	}
}
